name: dealroom
description: Connect Dealroom to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Dealroom MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Dealroom to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with startup and investor data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Dealroom workspace.
Find anything in Dealroom that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review startup and investor data in Dealroom.
